entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. I want my money back, and I don't want a runaround.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name's Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309. Just process the refund. Now.

Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Are you finding it's a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
There's no 'issue'! I just plain **changed my mind**. It was a stupid **impulse buy** and I **don't use it**. It's been sitting in its box for two weeks. I want my money back. Simple as that.
Okay, I understand. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for this item. One moment.

Check what? What is there to check?! This is ridiculous! I'm not going to be forced to sell this on some **resale** website because you guys won't honor your own policy! Get me a manager right now! This is unacceptable!
Sir, there's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you. I was just confirming the policy details. I see here that your item was delivered on January 5th.
Our knowledge base confirms that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that window, I cannot approve this return for a full refund.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what I thought. So a full refund, back to my card?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
